verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Forter publishes API reference pages (e.g. /reference/order-v3, /reference/order-status) and offers a sandbox/test environment. Nothing documents an interactive reference, a try-it console, or runnable examples. A static reference plus a separate sandbox environment is an adjacent capability, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
